Maine’s line is usually read as a general law that modern life has swapped birth-status for free contract. He was reporting a tendency he had seen so far in the private law of societies he called progressive: rights and duties the law attached to a person moved from the family position they were born into toward obligations they took on by agreement. “Progressive” and “hitherto” limit that claim to certain societies and to the past he could survey, and Status and Contract name the legal source of those personal rights and duties.

CONFIDENCE: 78
